regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood leads with 59" over the window, peaking at 31" Wednesday. Winds are strong, with gusts to 54 mph. Winter Storm Watch runs Tuesday night through Friday. Palisades and Sugar Bowl each show 48", peaking at 22" Wednesday.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth shows 42", peaking at 19" Wednesday. Winds reach gusts of 65 mph Wednesday night. Winter Storm Watch runs Wednesday through Friday. The NWS is calling for more, 46" to 69" Monday through Thursday night.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Snowbird and Alta each show 16", with 9" Tuesday. Snowbasin shows the same 16". The NWS is calling for more, 22" to 45" at Snowbird and 29" to 53" at Alta, Tuesday through Friday night.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee shows 11", with 8" Tuesday. The NWS is calling for more, 11" to 23" Tuesday through Friday night. Big Sky shows 9", with 6" Tuesday. Jackson Hole also shows 9".

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Telluride shows 9", peaking at 4" Friday. The NWS is calling for more, 8" to 15" Tuesday through Friday. Crested Butte shows 6", with 4" Friday. Steamboat shows 5" Friday.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek shows 9", with 5" Friday. Winds reach gusts of 60 mph Tuesday night and Friday. The NWS is calling for more, 17" to 33" Tuesday through Friday night. Taos shows 2".
